name: Alex Carter
cta_lines: Feel free to explore my portfolio and reach out

process.title: Discovery Call
process.text: In the first stage, we’ll have a Discovery Call to discuss your goals, needs, and project requirements. This helps us align our vision and set the foundation for a successful collaboration.

process.title: Proposal
process.text: I put together a scoped proposal with timeline, deliverables and pricing so everyone knows what success looks like before work starts.

process.title: Design
process.text: Research, flows and high-fidelity design in short cycles, with regular check-ins so feedback lands early.

process.title: Build
process.text: I work with your engineers to ship the design faithfully, covering edge cases, motion and accessibility.

process.title: Launch
process.text: We launch, measure what matters, and plan the next round of improvements together.
